name: Gravity Bomb, Mass Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 7, psychic 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

Targets one creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This functions as greater gravity bomb, except that it affects multiple creatures, the damage it deals each round is 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier, and it increases the bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage dealt to the target creature by any ranged attack or ranged spell by 10 points.
